THE CHINA PRESS, FRIDAY, JANUARY 3, 1930
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. I. O. D. 856...
Date..7.....1.....30.

America's Communist
Party Expel Former
Professor, Is Report

(Associated Press through Reuter)
New York, January 2.—The New
York Times understands that Mr.
Scott Nearing, whose political opin-
ions were responsible for the loss
of his professorships at the univ-
ersities of Pennsylvania and Toledo,
has now been expelled from the
Communist Party of America.
Nearing recently antagonised his
fellow-Communists by criticising
the way in which the Communist
Party ran its Presidential campaign
in 1928.

U.P.C.I.
Col. Holland is interested
in Mr. Scott Nearing.

4/2
M.S

POLITICAL BRANCH
(FOREIGN SECTION)
DATE 4 . 1 . 30
A.R. 8.1.

Inv
U.S. Sec

Mr. P.H.

《大陆报》，1930年1月3日，星期五
上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事侦缉处登记室
编号 I. O. D. 856...
日期..7.....1.....30.

据报美国共产党
开除前教授

（美联社通过路透社）
纽约，1月2日。——《纽约时报》获悉，斯科特·尼尔林（Scott Nearing）先生因其政治观点导致其失去了宾夕法尼亚大学和托莱多大学的教授职位，现已被美国共产党开除。
尼尔林最近因批评共产党在1928年总统竞选中的运作方式而与其共产党同志产生对立。

U.P.C.I.
霍兰德上校对斯科特·尼尔林先生感兴趣。

4/2
M.S

（外侨科）
